name: circuit-skills
description: Code-driven PCB design in Codex: the circuit-skills (pcb-layout, circuit-sim, pcb-enclosure-fit, pcb-3d-render) plus a viewer for the schematic, netlist, routed board with DRC markers, and 3D, and the board checks the pipeline gates on.

interface.longDescription: circuit-skills teaches the agent a code-driven PCB pipeline: tscircuit modules and placement, Freerouting with KiCad as the finisher, fab rules, and the gates that catch what exports and routers get wrong. The viewer shows a project the way the pipeline builds it: the schematic and netlist from the design, the routed KiCad board layer by layer with every DRC marker, an orbitable 3D view, and the drc / dfm / floating-pad checks with routing metrics. Open it from the sidebar, beside a conversation, or on any .kicad_pcb or .circuit.tsx file.
defaultPrompt: Open this project's board in the circuit viewer and check it.
Route the board with the pcb-layout pipeline, then show me the DRC markers that are left.
Compare pcb/ and pcb-rerun/: run check_board on both and tell me what differs.
